resources.string: Ask the keyboard not to learn what you type

OSHI encrypts on this phone, but what you type goes through your keyboard first. Incognito asks the keyboard not to learn or keep your words — Android cannot force a keyboard to obey, it can only ask. A third-party keyboard can still read every keystroke, so prefer your phone\'s built-in keyboard. If the phone itself is compromised (spyware), no app can protect what you type.
Your keyboard can read what you type before OSHI encrypts it
%1$s is a third-party keyboard. For private conversations, switch to your phone\'s built-in keyboard.
